items.title: Joe Williams interviewed by Leslie Gourse, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: suddenly on the radio, Milton J. Cross and the Metropolitan Opera. So I was given another vision other than the street

ctx.x: And they trapped me on Saturday. Instead of playing in the street, they’d say, “Darling, the windows need washing,” and we had a seven room house — I mean apartment — there in Chicago. So there I was washing the windows and suddenly on the radio, Milton J. Cross and the Metropolitan Opera. So I was given another vision other than the street and the houses of pleasure, and other things that I might have gotten into. And church every Sunday. Every Sunday was church. Sometimes I’d go to rehearsal with my mother.…
So there was always the encouragement there to the cultural-inclined, with music and —
